title: Dust Storm Emergency Assessment
subtitle: Outpost Systems Review and Validated Storm Shutdown
description: A gameplay-simulated dust storm requires a safety review, systems assessment and validated impact report. Outdoor access is temporarily restricted through the shared EVA policy until the report is accepted.

interfaces.resolution: Use the currently configured Habitat screen trigger and mesh.
Use the existing communications and systems console.
Use the mapped Module Status Display.
Verify the existing shared EVA access block; do not create another access system.
Review existing research/cultivation status and preserve the Sol 6 experiment.
Use the currently mapped power-unit screens and report values as source-backed, existing telemetry, unavailable, or gameplay simulation.
Reuse the existing report interface after Tasks 1–6 validate; no new report trigger is introduced.

tasks.title: Habitat: Dust Storm Alert
tasks.objective: Review the safety notice, temporary outdoor restriction and acknowledge the alert.

tasks.title: Mission Control: Systems Assessment
tasks.objective: Review power generation/reserve, communications, navigation and warnings; distinguish source-backed, existing telemetry, unavailable and simulated values.

tasks.title: Central Hub: Outpost Status
tasks.objective: Record section state and available distribution status without changing distribution.

tasks.title: Airlock: EVA Lockdown
tasks.objective: Verify that outdoor access is restricted through the global EVA/access-control policy.

tasks.title: Research Lab: Science Power
tasks.objective: Review science/cultivation power and the existing Sol 6 experiment without changing its sample, provenance or status.

tasks.title: Engineering: Power Assessment
tasks.objective: Read the existing power unit and record output, reserve, duration, panels A/B, outdoor line, distribution, life-support and science/cultivation availability. Mark simulated values.

tasks.title: Engineering: Report and Storm Shutdown
tasks.objective: Validate and submit the Tasks 1–6 impact report. Successful validation fades Sol 7 audio, restores captured lights, ends storm, restores existing EVA rules and persists the post-storm power assessment. Do not start Sol 8.

missionCompletion.completionMessage: Sol 7 storm assessment validated. Sol 8 remains inactive until the existing rest/progression flow advances.

storm.outdoorRestriction: Use global EVA/access-control route checks; do not replace suit rules.
storm.lights: Capture exact original properties before restrained red flicker; restore on report success and interrupted cleanup.

triggers: Outdoor main solar power line repair trigger
reservedSol8Repairs.resolution: Mappings not verified; do not interact or modify.

preservation.sol6Cultivation: preserve same sample, provenance and IN_PROGRESS status
preservation.nasaData: No external measurements asserted; telemetry is labeled by provenance.
